tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetches one issue by key (e.g. ENG-123). If you do not know the key, call `search_issues` first; to see comments, use `list_comments` afterwards.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Searches issues with a query. Combine with `get_issue` to read full details. Results are sorted by relevance.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Lists the comments of an issue. The issue must exist, otherwise `get_issue` returns an error.

tools.name: send_digest_email
tools.description: Sends a daily digest of open issues by email to the given address. Does not send anything without an explicit recipient.
